from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted liability information from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the report")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the reported liability")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'yuan', 'hundred_thousand', 'million')")
    liability_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the liability line item (e.g., '负债合计')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the liability figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_data: list[CompanyLiabilityData]
